Trifle Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 12:18am

Ingredients




1 pound pound cake (broken up)
1 lg. pkg. jello (strawberry or strawberry-banana)
1 can crushed pineapple
3 lg. fresh bananas
1 lg. instant vanilla pudding
Cool Whip
Walnuts and coconut

Preparation

1 Bake pound cake according to directions on box. Cool and break up into small pieces. Layer in rectangular pan. Prepare jello according to directions, refrigerate to pourable consistency (not congealed). Pour over cake. Layer pineapple and bananas.
